note: Consolidates owner-authorized design selections and latest placeholder-first workflow. This package was assembled for Codex migration; no Unity implementation or blanket execution/publishing approval is claimed.

rally.affected: all living friendly units including units spawned while active

battle.overtime: After 150s, both sides deal 2x base damage; no troop damage or income change. At 210s compare base HP fractions; exact tie ends as DRAW, not win.
battle.forced_app_stop: restart current battle from saved prebattle checkpoint; previous battle rewards persist

expedition.loadout_locked: from first draft until expedition ends

audience: 18+ intended; actual declarations must match finished product

numeric_contract.damage_hp_rounding: round positive half up once after additive modifier group; then flat reduction; minimum 1 for an eligible direct damage event
numeric_contract.cost_rounding: ceiling after summed additive cost modifiers; minimum 1
numeric_contract.clock_boundaries: At tick t: expire effects; add income for elapsed interval; settle an owed bonus if a slot is free; validate queued player commands; enemy deployment; movement/attacks; collect due damage; simultaneous damage; deaths; victory; hard-timeout if unresolved. No income at tick0.
numeric_contract.timer_expiry: Active for ticks start <= t < expiry. Overtime begins at tick 3000. No new enemy order at tick >=3600. Hard finish tick4200.
numeric_contract.movement_rounding: velocity fixed-point units/second; carry numerator remainder across 20-Hz steps; reset remainder only on spawn
numeric_contract.supply_rounding: fixed-point income with carried division remainder; no income at tick0; first at tick1
numeric_contract.range_measure: edge-to-edge horizontal gap, max(0,abs(centerA-centerB)-halfwidthA-halfwidthB); base front is zero-width target
numeric_contract.barrier_activation: on first positive post-mitigation incoming damage; grant barrier then absorb that same event; same-tick damage aggregate consumes one shield; never refresh
numeric_contract.enemy_funding: Regenerating bank starts as listed, capped at200; lifetime committed spend cannot exceed queue budget; queue is never repeated.
numeric_contract.save_identity: stable per-run/per-battle/per-reward IDs; UTC wall time never advances combat or income

formation_contract.slot_assignment: retain living eligible incumbents; fill vacant slots with closest eligible melee, ties by spawn ID; reserves may not attack until assigned. No teleport to slot.
formation_contract.unprotected_ranged: targetable at nearest opposing frontage whether or not a melee slot is occupied; continues its ordinary ranged attack if an eligible target is in range
formation_contract.target_selection: nearest opposing reachable centre by forward X distance then spawn ID; several attackers may target the same enemy; no invisible one-to-one pairing
formation_contract.base_attack_blocking: an opposing live body between attacker and base blocks base targeting regardless of whether it is in a melee slot
formation_contract.crossing: friendly ranged/melee may pass; opposing bodies cannot cross; resolve simultaneous approaching movement proportionally to proposed distances, with spawn-ID residual tie-break
formation_contract.crowding: three small presentation-only depth offsets do not affect range or create lanes; clamp movement against nearest opposing body
